scope: Interpretation of completed development audit; no new model inference or training
reviewer: AI-assisted audit, not independent human labels
core_interpretation: Positive pilot signal is chiefly associated with fewer unfinished episodes and fewer repeated invalid calls. It does not yet establish broadly improved semantic reasoning or causal use of diagnostic feedback.

representative_ai_trace_inspections.observation: A queries an attribute qualifier; C filters the intended entity and queries the country qualifier on the birthplace relation, matching the reference dependency structure.
C uses Or where A and the reference use And, returning 10 rather than 6. Both trajectories execute and finish.
C terminates after returning the identified person; A continues through the political-party relation requested by the question.
C selects a comparison with equality; A uses the greater-than comparison requested by the question.

limitations: Outcome-transition decomposition is descriptive; completion and reasoning are not causally independent mechanisms.
Reference-length and function groups were analyzed after observing the pilot and are exploratory, with overlapping memberships.
Both-finished accuracy is conditional on selected episode sets; do not generalize this subgroup as the entire reasoning capability.
The same 500 questions across seeds are not 1000 independent test questions.

decision.scope: conditional on initial adapter and fixed recovery corpus; not full end-to-end seed replication
decision.next_after_replication: Report both seeds without selection, then decide on feedback-screening diagnostic and paired B/D within existing budget. Do not automatically launch RL.
